visual_style: Original premium graphic-novel illustration; fine engraved ink lines, richly layered painted textures, chiaroscuro, cinematic lighting, physically plausible expressions, restrained mature palette, depth-separated environments. Avoid franchise imitation.
composition: Vertical 9:16, medium/cinematic closeups, foreground midground background, strong silhouettes, negative space for captions, visual storytelling, not a slideshow.
negative: blurry, plastic 3D render, amateur sketch, clipart, low-detail, malformed hands, duplicate limbs, inconsistent eyes, waxy skin, text, signatures, watermark, logos, oversaturated neon, franchise characters

locations.earth: Rain-drenched modern apartment and northern European city, bluish slate practical lighting, glass reflections, contemporary architecture and believable materials.
locations.noctaris: Original dark-fantasy twilight realm; imposing stone citadels and carved bridges beneath two moons, copper-violet clouds, fire-lit smoke, complex culture, no destroyed futuristic Earth.
